title: glossanthus malabaricus
intro: Glossanthus malabaricus, commonly known as Malabar cress, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Glossanthus malabaricus include its ability to act as an analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-emetic agent, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Glossanthus malabaricus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
